facts_about_kdp.blocked_titles_are_not_editable: Proven on the bookshelf, 21 Sep 2026: a title in BLOCKED state has no 'Edit eBook details / content / pricing' entry (every other title has digital_edit_details-<ref>); its title-setup URLs redirect to the bookshelf; its row offers only Archive. The publisher cannot edit a blocked title. The door for a content-review block is Amazon's review thread: 'If you have any questions, please reply to this email' — a reply on the thread stating the corrected metadata and asking the review team to apply it and release the block.
facts_about_kdp.an_outward_reply_is_hers: A reply to Amazon goes from her account, in her name. Simone drafts it (reply_template below), proposes it as ONE ask with the draft in it, and sends it only on her word — through the Gmail connector's reply on the review thread, never from a Boss OS address.
